[ImagePicker - Expo Documentation](https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v54.0.0/sdk/imagepicker)\n\n# Expo ImagePicker Android IllegalStateException: Unregistered ActivityResultLauncher\n\n## The Problem\n\nThe &#96;IllegalStateException: Attempting to launch an unregistered ActivityResultLauncher&#96; error occurs when calling &#96;launchImageLibraryAsync&#96; or &#96;launchCameraAsync&#96; on Android.[1] This error prevents the image picker from launching and can only be resolved by reinstalling the app.[1]\n\n## Trigger Conditions\n\nThe issue appears specifically when:[1]\n\n- Location tracking via task manager is active when the app is closed\n- The app is reopened\n- &#96;launchCameraAsync&#96; or &#96;launchImageLibraryAsync&#96; is called\n- The error does NOT occur if location tracking wasn't active when the app was last closed\n\n## Root Cause\n\nThe error is related to the &#96;ActivityResultLauncher&#96; contract not being properly registered when the activity is recreated after the app is backgrounded and certain background tasks (like location tracking) are running.[1]\n\n## Migration Context\n\nExpo migrated the image-picker to use the &#96;registerForActivityResult&#96; API, which uses &#96;Contracts&#96; to handle activity results.[3] This migration aimed to modernize the Android implementation but appears to have introduced this edge case where the launcher state isn't properly maintained across activity recreation cycles when background tasks are active.[3]\n\n## Related Issues\n\nA similar casting error has been reported where &#96;launchImageLibraryAsync&#96; fails with: \"The 1st argument cannot be cast to type expo.modules.imagepicker.ImagePickerOptions\"[4], suggesting there may be multiple related state management issues with the ActivityResultLauncher on Android.",

[Expo ImagePicker fails to launch. Call to function 'ExponentImagePicker.launchCameraAsync' has been rejected. · Issue #19512 · expo/expo](https://github.com/expo/expo/issues/19512)\n\n# Expo Image Picker \"Unregistered ActivityResultLauncher\" Fix\n\n## Root Cause\nThe error \"Attempting to launch an unregistered ActivityResultLauncher\" occurs when the Activity is destroyed and recreated by the system before the launcher can be used.[1][4][5] This commonly happens when:\n- The app is backgrounded and the system kills the Activity\n- Location tracking via task manager is active when the app closes\n- Permissions are granted after the initial request[4]\n\n## Solutions\n\n### For Expo Image Picker Users (Android)\nExpo migrated their image picker to use &#96;registerForActivityResult&#96; in version 46+.[2] If you're experiencing this issue:\n- Update to the latest version of &#96;expo-image-picker&#96;\n- Use &#96;ImagePicker.getPendingResultAsync()&#96; to handle cases where the Activity was destroyed during image picking[3]\n\n### General Android ActivityResultLauncher Fix\nIf building custom code:[1]\n\n1. **Register the launcher in &#96;onCreate()&#96;:**\nRegister &#96;registerForActivityResult&#96; during the Activity's &#96;onCreate&#96; method, not later in the lifecycle.[1]\n\n2. **Add null checks before launching:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;java\nif(activityResultLauncher != null)\n    activityResultLauncher.launch(intent);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;[1]\n\n3. **Set launcher to null on Activity destruction:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;java\n@Override\nprotected void onDestroy() {\n    super.onDestroy();\n    activityResultLauncher = null;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;[1]\n\n## Note\nThe old &#96;startActivityForResult()&#96; and &#96;onActivityResult()&#96; methods are deprecated in favor of &#96;registerForActivityResult&#96;.[3]",

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Re-registering launchers**

I'm re-registering launchers in ImagePickerModule on host resume to avoid using stale launchers. 

**Handling race conditions**

I'm implementing async handling for launcher re-registration to prevent race conditions during host resume. I'm using mainQueue.launch to asynchronously register contracts on the next frame to prevent race conditions. I'm scheduling contract registration on mainQueue asynchronously to prevent race conditions, but user taps before registration completes, causing IllegalStateException. User can tap image picker before async registration completes, risking IllegalStateException on slow devices. I'm investigating whether `InteractionManager.runAfterInteractions` interleaves poorly with activity lifecycle during picker return. 

I'm exploring alternative approaches for Android image library calls during activity transitions, considering synchronous launch vs. deferred execution with requestAnimationFrame. </details></think>

_**Agent (default)**_


确认根因：Expo 的 `ActivityResultLauncher` 在 Activity 重建（例如从相册返回、`hostWasDestroyed` 后异步重新注册）后可能短暂失效；当前在 Android 上用 `InteractionManager.runAfterInteractions` + `setTimeout(0)` 会推迟 `launch`，容易与重新注册时机冲突。将改为在用户手势链内直接调用 `launchImageLibraryAsync`，并对 `unregistered ActivityResultLauncher` 做短暂重试。

## 原因说明

报错 `Attempting to launch an unregistered ActivityResultLauncher` 来自 Expo Modules 在 Android 上的 `ActivityResult` 注册机制：当 **MainActivity 被系统销毁再创建**（从系统相册返回、开启开发者选项「不保留活动」、内存回收等）时，会先 `unregister` 旧的 `ActivityResultLauncher`，再在 `onHostResume` 里 **异步**执行 `registerActivityContracts`。  

原先在 `chat-to-log.tsx` 里对 Android 使用了 `InteractionManager.runAfterInteractions` + `setTimeout(0)`，会把 `launchImageLibraryAsync` **推迟到稍后一帧**执行，更容易掉进「注册尚未完成就已经 launch」或「仍持有已失效的 launcher」的时间窗，**连续第二次打开相册**时尤其明显。

## 修改说明

1. **去掉 Android 上的推迟调用**：权限通过后**立刻**在同一轮逻辑里调用相册（仍由用户点击触发，避免无谓延迟）。  
2. **增加针对性重试**：仅当错误信息匹配 `unregistered ActivityResultLauncher` 时，间隔 **120ms / 280ms** 再最多重试两次（共最多 3 次 `launch`），给原生侧完成重新注册留出时间。

涉及文件：`vouchap-app/src/mobile-ui/app/chat-to-log.tsx`（新增 `launchImageLibraryAsyncWithAndroidRelaunchRetries` / `isAndroidImagePickerLauncherNotReadyError`）。  

## 建议你本地验证

在 Chat to log（Expenses）里 **连续多次**点图片按钮选图；若开了 **「不保留活动」**，也请测一遍。若仍有极小概率失败，可把重试间隔略调大（例如 200 / 400ms）。  

已在 `docs/PRD-SOURCE-LOG.md` 追加对应溯源记录。
